column3: A bold, simple open box (a cube-shaped storage box seen slightly from the front, lid flaps open) in warm white. On the front face of the box is a clean clock face drawn with two thick plum clock hands; the box has one flat paper document page (a plain rectangular sheet, NOT an envelope) peeking up out of the top, with a marigold corner. The idea reads instantly as 'Due' (clock) + 'box'.

A single flat rectangular paper document sheet (a plain official letter page with three short grey text-line bars, NOT an envelope, no flap, no V shape), slightly rotated. Pressed onto its lower-right corner is a bold round marigold rubber-stamp seal shape with a small plum clock symbol inside it (no text, no numbers). The idea reads as 'official letter with a due date'.

A single tear-off calendar page in warm white with two small binder rings on top and a plum header band; on the page, one bold rounded marigold square marks a single day, and a thick plum check mark sits over that marked day. Grid of the other days shown only as tiny faint dots. NOT an envelope. The idea reads as 'deadline handled'.

A bold geometric capital letter D in warm white, drawn as a solid open box: the straight left side and curved right side are thick walls, the inner space is the box's inside. One flat white rectangular paper page (NOT an envelope) is dropping into the D from above, its top-right corner folded and coloured marigold. Very simple, flat with subtle depth, only three shapes, must be readable at 40px.
